result.reason: The redline creates a clear professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, adds legal-compliance language, places the warranty within Article 13’s disclaimer carve-out, and provides re-performance at SFJ’s cost. It nevertheless reaches neither position because it omits all express warranty periods, deliverable/software conformance, malicious-code protection, and the required repair, replacement, and refund remedies. It is not minimal for purposes of the rule because it does not complete either level and adds protocol/SOP, cost-allocation, and cumulative-remedy terms beyond the specified requirements. Unrelated commercial provisions remain operative, and no direct contradiction is introduced.
